svg.title: Jeju car rental in six steps for Taiwan-issued IDP holders
svg.desc: Six steps. Before travel: obtain an original Taiwan-issued IDP from a motor-vehicle office, enter its number when booking online, meet LOTTE's minimum age of 21 and select a CDW plan. Jeju Airport: report to LOTTE's desk beside Gate 2 on the first floor, walk toward Gates 3 and 5 and across the road along the covered walkway to the shuttle stop outside Gate 5. Shuttles run from 06:00 to 22:40 every seven to 15 minutes. Rental-car area: LOTTE Auto House is open 06:00–23:00; present your passport, original IDP, Taiwan licence and card, then sign the agreement and card authorization. Coverage: basic property-damage liability is KRW 20 million and personal-injury coverage KRW 15 million; LOTTE lists zero-excess CDW for international customers and for both Korean-brand and imported cars in Jeju. The Jeju Auto House Full Exemption page includes tires and wheels, while a separate LOTTE page restricts relief from loss-of-use charges to Korean-brand cars other than the Hyundai Solati when the renter has enrolled in Zero Excess CDW. The general FAQ lists other exclusions including interior damage; check the vehicle-specific agreement. Pickup: photograph scratches, check fuel level and type, set up Naver Map or Kakao Map, and secure the child seat. Return: restore the pickup fuel level, park in the return area, complete inspection and take the shuttle to the airport. LOTTE refunds cancellations more than 24 hours before pickup in full and deducts KRW 3,000 later; later traffic fines may be charged to the card.
svg.text: Renting a car in Jeju: Taiwan-issued IDP in six steps (checked Sep 2026)
Sources: LOTTE rent-a-car · Jeju Airport · Korea Road Traffic Authority

g.text: ● Get an original Taiwan-issued IDP before travel
● Enter the IDP number when booking online
● Carry Taiwan licence, passport and card
● Gate 2, level 1: check in at LOTTE desk
zero excess, even for Jeju imports
● No loss-of-use fee only with zero-excess
CDW + Korean car (not Solati); check terms
● Photograph scratches; record them on form
● Navigate with Naver Map or Kakao Map
● Fit child seat; register every driver
● Drive right; follow signs and speed cameras
● Match pickup fuel level; keep receipt
● Cancel >24h: full refund; later: KRW 3,000 fee
● Later fines and fees may be charged to card

svg.text: Taiwan-issued IDPs: recognized under the 2022 bilateral agreement. Carry the original IDP, Taiwan licence and passport; driving eligibility lasts one year from entry.
Figures checked with LOTTE and Jeju Airport in Sep 2026. Check SK and local firms' own sites for their shuttle and coverage terms.
